purpose: Tall mature plants with larger leaves and harvest parts, dark edges

species.name: glass-dewberry
species.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target, a tall mature botanical game asset. Keep exactly ONE complete plant, its tall open branching skeleton and species. This edit must ENLARGE EACH LEAF and EACH FLOWER/FRUIT relative to the plant, and give each one a strong DARK colored outline for readability against Stardew Valley crops. Preserve the approximately 1:2 width:height plant silhouette and the tall vertical spacing; do not turn it into a squat bouquet.
Geometry: 4 large broad supporting leaves only, broad solid blades sweeping to the left and right. Each leaf blade spans 45-50% of the full plant width and has a broad thick face, not a narrow ribbon. Main harvest parts should each span 50-55% of full plant width, around 20-24% of its full height, at staggered heights with short visible stem segments between them. Their scale is more important than little decorative leaves. The main stem is firm, slightly curved and readable. Keep the mature plant tall: its visible bounding box is twice as high as wide. Use the full portrait canvas with modest transparent margins.
Polished simplified hand-painted 2D farming-game art with saturated natural greens and jewel tones. Two or three clean broad light/shadow planes, no micro-texture. DARK forest-green leaf edges, dark species-colored flower/fruit edges. Avoid pale leaf edging and overall white wash. Truly transparent alpha background. No pot, soil, shadow, extra plants, text or border. All leaves and harvest parts attached. This source will reduce to a 12x26 pixel body with a further dark one-pixel game contour, so shapes must be big and simple.
Preserve exactly THREE ROUND blue/cyan glass berries on alternating high-left, mid-right and low-left curved pedicels. Enlarge each berry to approximately HALF of the total plant width and keep them round. Compact ivory highlights, cobalt shadow and dark navy outline. Four huge deep-teal green leaves with light green faces and dark forest contours. Remove little decorative leaf clutter.
